messages:
emma.marketing: Hey team — we need a compact, modular set of benchmark assets for the launch and upcoming webinar. Think: one atomic Figma template that can output hero banners, social tiles, email headers, and a single-page inbound routing diagram. Goal: make it plug-and-play for SDRs and the webinar landing page.

javier.design: Do you mean one master file with symbols/variants, or separate files for each channel?

emma.marketing: Master file with component variants. Designers should be able to toggle metrics (latency/cost/throughput) and switch between product copy tiers. Also need a lightweight PNG export preset for marketing ops.

sam.content: For copy — I'll draft 2 headline sets: product-forward and outcome-forward. Which voice should we prioritize for the webinar hero?

emma.marketing: Start with outcome-forward for hero (e.g., "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost"). Product-forward for social tiles is fine.

javier.design: Got it. Quick ask for data format: will you provide the benchmark numbers as CSV or JSON? I need canonical numbers for the metrics components.

emma.marketing: CSV preferred. I'll drop sample rows in this thread by EOD. Also: include template tokens so content can be auto-filled by our CMS, e.g., {{model}}, {{p50_latency_ms}}, {{tokens_per_sec}}.

javier.design: Saved. Two quick constraints: 1) keep hero safe for 4:3 and 16:9 crops, 2) tiles should work legibly at 120px width.

maddie.ops: For exports, ops needs these presets: hero (1200x628, PNG), social tile (1080x1080, PNG and 600x600 JPG fallback), email header (600x200, high-res PNG), inbound-diagram (1200x600 SVG + PNG). Also: add S3-friendly filename pattern: launch_bench_{variant}_{locale}.png

priya.brand: Brand checks — please avoid using the secondary blue (#0A9EFF) as full-bleed background for hero. Use brand-primary gradient + subtle ink overlay for contrast. Track font weights: Inter variable 400/600 only. Include accessible color contrast for text (AA for body, AAA for headings if possible).

legalbot: Reminder: do not include any customer-identifying metrics or PII in public assets. If you need example numbers, mark them as anonymized or placeholder. Also run the final assets through legal review before publish.

oliver.product: Also add a small, optional micro-diagram for inbound flow that shows: Landing page -> Webinar signup -> HubSpot tagging -> SDR routing. We need the diagram to match our routing playbook icons.

javier.design: Drafting the component library now. Quick spec I put in the Figma file:

```
component: benchmark-tile
variants: [hero, social-600, social-1080, email-header, micro-diagram]
sizes:
  hero: 1200x628
  social-1080: 1080x1080
  social-600: 600x600
  email-header: 600x200
  micro-diagram: flexible, export as SVG
fonts: Inter var (400,600)
colors: brand-primary-gradient, brand-ink-90 for overlay
exports: PNG @1x, PNG @2x (for hero), SVG for diagram
naming: launch_bench_{variant}_{locale}.png
```

javier.design: ETA — I can upload a first-pass file by tomorrow noon PST.

emma.marketing: Perfect. I'll attach the sample CSV and the webinar deck content after standup.

sam.content: Two headline options posted in the doc — linking here: https://figma.com/file/bench-copy-draft (inline comments enabled).

javier.design: First pass uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/zzz123/atomic-bench-templates — left comments on the metric tokens and export slices. Please add any edge-case locale strings in comments.

priya.brand: Reviewed the first pass — small tweak: bump text padding on the hero when metric module is enabled (to avoid overlap at 4:3). Otherwise looks brand safe. :white_check_mark:

maddie.ops: Ops check: make sure the exported PNGs include the locale code and do not exceed 200KB for social tiles. If >200KB, create a JPG fallback.

emma.marketing: Thanks everyone — next steps: I'll upload CSV, legalbot will queue review, and Javier will iterate on comments. Aim to lock final assets by EOD Friday for the webinar go-live.

legalbot: Noted — tagging for review once assets are added to shared drive.

javier.design: Noted — I'll address brand padding and add 2 color-contrast variants for accessibility testing.

emma.marketing: Awesome. Closing the loop here — please drop final export links in this thread when ready. :rocket:
